I need to finish the frontend implementation for Teich Studio. So far I've added the static assets: index.html, style.css, and the xterm vendor files. I also updated the server to expose a WebSocket endpoint for the terminal. The next logical piece is the JavaScript that powers the UI: handling API calls, navigation, status loading, configuration, prompts, generation, interactive sessions, terminal integration, and trace browsing.

The user just asked for “the rewritten app.js with the xterm terminal client”. I have already prepared most of the UI logic in earlier steps, but I still need to write the full app.js file. I should include a strict mode header, utility functions (api wrapper, toast, element creation, formatting helpers), global state, navigation, status loading, config form handling, prompts management, generate view, interactive session handling (including terminal mounting with xterm.js and FitAddon), SSE handling for both generate and session events, chat UI, trace loading and preview, and an init routine that ties everything together.

All of these functions must reference the DOM elements defined in index.html (e.g., #toast, #nav-prompts-count, #provider-grid, etc.) and use the API endpoints I've set up on the server (e.g., /api/status, /api/config, /api/prompts, /api/generate, /api/sessions). The terminal client should create a new Terminal, load the FitAddon, open it in the #terminal container, and connect to the WebSocket at `/api/sessions/${session.id}/term`. I need to handle stdin/stdout messages and display connection status.

Given the extensive code already drafted in my mind, I will now write the entire content of src/teich/studio/static/app.js with all these pieces, ensuring correct syntax, proper escaping of backticks, and matching the structure I've used elsewhere. I will use a Write tool call to create/overwrite the file at the correct path with the full JavaScript content.

This will satisfy the request for the rewritten app.js that includes the xterm terminal client and integrates all UI functionality.
